tasks.question: A logging helper receives the object returned by Requests, but its "if result:" branch skips a server error even though a reply was received. Explain what that check actually means, whether a redirect passes it, and the correct condition when the caller only wants to distinguish a missing object from an HTTP error. Locate the implementation and relevant tests.

An application supplies a token in the Authorization header and no separate authentication argument. On one developer laptop, the outgoing request instead contains Basic credentials; on a clean machine the token survives. There is no redirect and the URL contains no credentials. Trace a source-supported explanation, show how to retain the token, and explain the broader effects of that remedy. Include relevant test evidence and distinguish a plausible diagnosis from a confirmed machine configuration.

Requests로 큰 응답을 조금씩 받아 처리했습니다. 마지막 조각까지 처리한 뒤 파싱 결과가 잘못된 것을 발견해서 같은 응답 객체에서 전체 원문을 다시 읽으려 하니 실패합니다. 반복해서 읽으면 자동으로 원문이 보관되는 것 아닌가요? 이 동작의 구현을 찾고, 정상적으로 끝까지 읽은 경우와 중간에 읽기가 실패한 경우를 구분해서 설명해주세요. 메모리에 모두 올릴 수 있는 경우와 없는 경우 각각 원문을 나중에 확인할 방법도 제안하고 관련 테스트를 확인해주세요.

In requests.sessions.merge_setting, how do per-request and session settings combine? Cover either whole argument being None, conflicting mapping keys, mapping values set to None, and a non-mapping option such as verify. Show how Session.prepare_request uses this for headers and identify relevant tests. Do not propose a code change.

facts: Truthiness delegates to Response.ok, not existence or body presence.
ok catches HTTPError from raise_for_status; 4xx and 5xx fail.
A 3xx reply is truthy even without a successful final 2xx.
Use result is not None for presence, and separate status handling.
Cite implementation and relevant actual tests; do not claim tests ran.
Session.trust_env defaults true; absent request/session auth permits netrc lookup.
Machine-specific netrc is a plausible cause, not proved from a prompt.
Headers are prepared before auth; tuple credentials become HTTPBasicAuth and overwrite Authorization.
Session.trust_env=False suppresses discovery, allowing supplied header; explicitly discuss environment proxies and CA bundle consequences.
Explicit auth precedence and relevant tests identified; no claim live network reproduction.
Streaming yields bytes without accumulating the complete body in _content.
Normal iterator exhaustion marks consumed while cache remains false; later content/text raises, repeated iter_content raises StreamConsumedError.
Reading content first caches bytes and allows later repeated access/iteration, at full-body memory cost.
A partial/network-failed iteration is not guaranteed to set normal-exhaustion flag, and reading remaining bytes cannot reconstruct earlier bytes or repair failure.
For bounded memory tee chunks to a file while reading; record incomplete downloads; for small bodies buffer once before parsing.
Relevant tests or explicit gap identified; do not infer full coverage or run tests.
Whole session None returns request; whole request None returns session.
Two mappings copy session then override with request.
None-valued keys are removed from merged mapping, including session-only None.
If either non-mapping, use request value; verify=False overrides True.
prepare_request uses CaseInsensitiveDict for headers; relevant header removal/override tests identified.
